stem.text: At temperatures close to $0\,\text{K}$, the specific heat capacity $c$ of a particular solid is given by $c = bT^{3}$, where $T$ is the temperature and $b$ is a constant, characteristic of the solid. The SI unit of specific heat capacity is $\text{J kg}^{-1}\,\text{K}^{-1}$.
What is the unit of constant $b$, expressed in SI base units?
